title: Global Village Perks
body:
Three free MUD-wide perks run at random times in each 24-hour cycle. Each window lasts 30 minutes. The game announces one double or triple boost for each of experience, damage, and ryo. The schedule survives reboots.

Immortals of helper rank and higher can use vperk list and vperk status. Use vperk <perk> on or vperk on <perk> to start or renew a 24-hour override. Use vperk <perk> off or vperk off <perk> to end it. Available perks are double exp, triple exp, double damage, triple damage, double ryo, and triple ryo.

Immortal overrides take priority in their category. When a Kage purchase and an automatic perk share a category, the higher multiplier applies. Kage purchases last one hour in their village. Active EXP perks also boost successful job actions.
